atmosphere.source: Dry ISA-1976 thermodynamic states with ITU-R P.453-14 refractivity
atmosphere.humidity_basis: dry-air reference; e=0 is an assumption, not a measurement

diagnostics.supported_family: short-arc, spherical, horizontally stratified, strictly increasing q=n*r; radial-monotonic or one lower radial minimum; no ducts/multipath

assumptions: spherical symmetry and horizontally homogeneous refractive index n(h)
smooth absorbing spherical ground; no terrain, diffraction, reflection, or multipath
phase index treated as nondispersive for optical travel time
physical Earth radius used; no effective-Earth-radius correction

method_separation.geometric_straight_path: independent vacuum chord shown for comparison
method_separation.effective_earth_radius: independent reference only; not called and never used as fallback

scope_limits: short-arc radial-monotonic and single-minimum direct families only
smooth spherical ground; no terrain, diffraction, reflection, ducting, multipath, or coverage search
numerical/software verification is not experimental field validation
